research.notes: Closed: the 2026 application period "was from November 4, 2025, to December 11, 2025" (DECISIONS #19); no 2027 dates are posted, and the live check flags the page when they are. Type wage_subsidy and purpose hire are on the page. Employees: the 50-or-fewer limit applies only to private sector employers; not-for-profit and public sector employers have no size limit on the page, and the profile's structure answer does not say private or public sector, so it is a check-yourself item rather than an employees rule that would wrongly rule out a large non-profit. Cost share: 50% is the rate for public and private sector employers; not-for-profits get "up to 100%" of the minimum wage plus mandatory employment costs, which is left in notes rather than chosen as the headline. No location rule (national program; nothing on these pages restricts it by province). No phone is on these three pages. The main Canada Summer Jobs page (the url) has no intake wording, so it is not a source.
